title: "Building a Toolkit for Design" by Matthew Griffith
summary: Matthew Griffith, creator of elm-ui, presents a toolkit for designing layouts in Elm as an alternative to CSS. He explains the opinionated approach to layout and styling.
why: HN commenters recommend it as a fresh perspective on layout and styling in CSS discussions.

quote.text: For those who want a fresh perspective on CSS, layout and styling, check out this talk by Matthew Griffith
